gloss: painting (on ceramics, pottery); decorating with designs

definitions.gloss: painting designs on ceramics or pottery; decorative painting
definitions.explanation: The craft of applying decorative patterns or pictures onto pottery, porcelain, or other ceramics, either before or after glazing.

examples.japanese: {絵付|えつ}けを{体験|たいけん}する。
examples.english: To try one's hand at ceramic painting.

examples.japanese: この{皿|さら}は{手描|てが}きの{絵付|えつ}けが{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: This plate has beautiful hand-painted designs.

examples.japanese: {窯元|かまもと}で{絵付|えつ}け{体験|たいけん}ができるツアーに{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I joined a tour where you can try ceramic painting at a kiln workshop.

notes:
A compound of {絵|え} (picture, painting) and {付|つ}け (applying, attaching). Refers to the craft of painting decorative patterns or pictures onto pottery, porcelain, or other ceramics before or after glazing. A key step in traditional Japanese pottery production. Often offered as an activity at pottery studios and tourist destinations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絵付|えつ}け{体験|たいけん}: ceramic painting experience
- {絵付|えつ}け{師|し}: ceramic painter (artisan)
- {手描|てが}きの{絵付|えつ}け: hand-painted decoration
- {下絵付|したえつ}け: underglaze painting (applied before glazing)
- {上絵付|うわえつ}け: overglaze painting (applied after initial firing)

RELATED WORDS:
- {焼|や}き{物|もの}: pottery, ceramics — the broader field
- {釉薬|ゆうやく}: glaze — the coating applied before firing
- {陶芸|とうげい}: ceramic art, pottery making — the art form as a whole
